title: Form questions and option descriptions render as markdown, with working links
body:
coax draws an agent's question form with `draw_form` and `form_lines` in `src/ui.rs`. A question's title, its description and each option's description go in as plain strings, wrapped by `wrap` and styled whole. Agent text in the conversation goes through `cmr::parse` and `cmr::layout`. That pass draws `inline code` and bold, and it makes `foam:` and `file:` links hover and click.

So a form that names an issue shows `coax-ee3b4d` as bare text. The person has to look the issue up by its id to learn what it is. Backticks and bold show as the characters typed.

## Proposal

- Each question's title, description and option descriptions go through cmr at the form's width, as agent text does.
- Links in the form register in `App::link_areas` as links in the conversation do. A `foam:` link shows the issue in the hover popup, and a click opens its target.
- Inline markdown only. A heading, a list or a table in a form string is drawn as its text.

## Open

- Whether option titles render too, or stay plain so the columns line up.
- How the form's keys and a click on a link share the mouse.
